headline_marked: [[Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 leaks]] show familiar design, major internal upgrade to Snapdragon Wear
headline: Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 leaks show familiar design, major internal upgrade to Snapdragon Wear
summary: New renders suggest Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 will retain its squircle design, but an upgrade to Qualcomm's Snapdragon Wear chip promises significant performance and AI improvements.
details: High-quality renders of the Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 have surfaced, indicating that the smartwatch will largely maintain the squircle design of its predecessor. The three physical buttons on the right side also appear to remain in their original positions.

The primary external changes are expected to be new color options, including a black/gray finish and a deep green shade. Additional exclusive colors might be available through Samsung's online store and in specific markets.
Based on the leaked markings, the Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 is reportedly built with a 47mm chassis, offering 10ATM water resistance and sapphire crystal glass. It will also support LTE connectivity.

While not detailed in the renders, Samsung has confirmed a switch to Qualcomm's new Snapdragon Wear chip for future Galaxy Watch models. This means the Ultra 2 is expected to feature the Snapdragon Wear Elite platform, bringing substantial performance boosts and a dedicated NPU for AI tasks.

This new chip will replace the current Exynos W1000, which, despite decent CPU performance, is showing its age in connectivity. The Snapdragon Wear Elite platform will introduce support for Bluetooth 6.0, UWB, Micro-Power Wi-Fi, and 5G RedCap.
The enhanced CPU, GPU, and NPU from the Snapdragon Wear chip are anticipated to significantly elevate the Galaxy Watch Ultra 2's capabilities, helping it truly live up to its 'Ultra' moniker.
Samsung's next Galaxy Unpacked event is rumored for the third week of July in London, where the company is expected to officially unveil its new foldable phones and smartwatch lineup.

This new chip will replace the current Exynos W1000, which, despite decent CPU performance, is showing its age in connectivity. The Snapdragon Wear Elite platform will introduce support for Bluetooth 6.0, UWB, Micro-Power Wi-Fi, and 5G RedCap.
